gaps.sentence: I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: You should cut down ___ sugar if you want to lose weight.
gaps.explanation: cut down ON something = reduce it; cut out = eliminate completely.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: We saw our guests ___ at the station.
gaps.explanation: see somebody off = go with a traveller to say goodbye.
